title: The Temple Tax and the Stater in the Fish
description: In Capernaum, those who collected the temple tax asked Peter if Jesus paid the tax. Jesus explained that kings' sons are free, but to avoid causing offense, he told Peter to cast a hook into the sea. In the mouth of the first fish, Peter would find a stater to pay the tax for both of them. [ref:Matt 17:24-27|Matthew 17:24-27]
